title: Keep only what qualifies
body: Filter expresses selection without managing a result list manually.
takeaway: Filter answers: which existing items should remain?

title: Many values become one
body: Which operation combines a collection into a single accumulated result?
takeaway: Fold carries an accumulator through every item.

title: Name the side effects
body: Network calls, file writes, logs, and mutable global state make results depend on more than inputs.
takeaway: Isolate effects behind explicit boundaries so the core stays testable.

title: Build behavior from small steps
body: Function composition pipes one function's output into the next function's input.
takeaway: Small focused transformations are easier to test and reuse.

title: Change data without mutation
body: Create a new value while preserving every field that did not change.

title: Replace a call with its value
body: What property allows an expression to be replaced by its result without changing behavior?

title: Compute only when needed
body: Lazy iteration can stop after finding enough results instead of materializing an entire pipeline.
takeaway: Delay work when consumers may need only part of a sequence.

title: Map, then flatten
body: Which operation turns each input into a collection and combines the results?
takeaway: Flat-map is useful for nested collections and dependent async steps.

title: Configure a function in stages
body: Currying turns a multi-argument function into a chain of one-argument functions.
takeaway: Partial application creates specialized functions from general ones.

title: Why did the old screen change?
body: Two screens reference the same mutable list. One appends an item. What caused the surprise?
takeaway: Copy collections before changing them, or expose immutable views.
